text: # Battery Safety — NovaVolt Electronics All NovaVolt lithium-ion products (earbuds, power banks, speakers) are tested to IEC 62133 safety standards. Even so, customers should stop using and immediately unplug/power off any device that shows swelling, unusual heat, a burning smell, or leakage, and contact support rather than continuing to charge or use it. Do not puncture, crush, disassemble, incinerate, or expose NovaVolt batteries to temperatures above 60°C (e.g., a car dashboard in direct sun). Do not leave devices charging unattended overnight on soft surfaces like a bed or sofa, which can trap heat. # International Shipping — NovaVolt Electronics

NovaVolt currently ships internationally to Nepal, Sri Lanka, UAE, and Singapore only. International
orders take 10-18 business days and are shipped DDU (Delivery Duty Unpaid) — the recipient is
responsible for any customs duties or import taxes charged on arrival, which NovaVolt cannot predict
or pre-pay on the customer's behalf.

Power banks (like the PB20000) cannot be shipped internationally by air due to lithium battery air
freight restrictions; international orders containing a power bank will have that item automatically
removed with a refund for that line item, and the rest of the order shipped normally.

NovaVolt does not currently ship outside the four countries listed above.

# Order Tracking — NovaVolt Electronics You can track an order from the "My Orders" page using your order ID (format: NV-XXXXXX) or by clicking the tracking link sent by SMS/email once the order ships. Order statuses, in order: Placed → Confirmed → Packed → Shipped → Out for Delivery → Delivered. An order can also show Cancelled or Return Requested. If tracking shows no movement for more than 2 days, this usually means the shipment is awaiting courier pickup or is held at a transit hub — it does not necessarily mean the order is lost. # Payment Methods — NovaVolt Electronics

NovaVolt accepts UPI, all major credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, Amex), net banking, and
Cash on Delivery (COD) for orders under ₹15,000. COD carries a ₹29 handling fee.

NovaVolt also supports 3-month and 6-month no-cost EMI on credit cards for orders above ₹5,000, subject
to the issuing bank's eligibility rules — NovaVolt does not control bank-side EMI approval and cannot
guarantee a specific bank will approve EMI for a given customer.

If a payment is deducted but the order shows "Payment Failed," the amount is auto-reversed by the bank
within 5-7 business days. NovaVolt does not hold failed-payment funds and cannot manually speed up a
bank-side reversal.

# Product: NovaVolt BS5 Portable Bluetooth Speaker

Price: ₹3,299. 20W output, IPX6 water resistance (safe for rain/splashes, not for submersion), 12-hour
battery life at 60% volume, Bluetooth 5.1 with a 10m typical range (line of sight).

Supports pairing two BS5 speakers together in stereo mode via the NovaVolt Connect app. Has a USB-C
charging port and a 3.5mm aux-in for wired sources.

Floats on water but is not designed to be submerged or used underwater — "IPX6" rates resistance to
powerful water jets, not immersion. Submersion is not covered under warranty.

# Product: NovaVolt PD65 USB-C Laptop Charger

Price: ₹1,799. 65W USB-C Power Delivery charger, compatible with most USB-C laptops (MacBook Air/Pro
up to 14", Dell XPS, HP Spectre, Lenovo ThinkPad with USB-C PD charging) as well as phones/tablets that
support USB-C PD fast charging.

Includes: PD65 adapter, 1.5m braided USB-C to USB-C cable. Input: 100-240V (works worldwide with a
plug adapter, voltage auto-switching). Over-current, over-voltage, and over-heat protection built in.

Note: laptops that charge only via a proprietary barrel connector (older Dell/HP/Lenovo models without
USB-C PD) are NOT compatible with the PD65 — check your laptop's charging port before ordering.

# Product: NovaVolt PB20000 Power Bank

Price: ₹2,199. 20,000mAh capacity, 22.5W fast charging output (USB-C and USB-A ports, one of each),
18W USB-C PD input for recharging the bank itself (~3.5 hours from empty with a PD charger).

Can charge a typical smartphone roughly 3.5-4 times, or a tablet about 1.5 times, before needing a
recharge — actual numbers vary by device battery health and charging losses, so NovaVolt states these
as typical ranges, not guarantees.

Airline carry-on note: 20,000mAh (≈74Wh) is within the common 100Wh carry-on limit for most airlines,
but passengers should confirm with their specific airline before flying, as rules vary.

# Product: NovaVolt SP2 Smart Wi-Fi Plug

Price: ₹899. 10A smart plug, works over 2.4GHz Wi-Fi (does not support 5GHz networks), controlled via
the "NovaVolt Home" app. Supports scheduling, away-mode random on/off, and voice control through
Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant (after linking the NovaVolt Home skill/action).

Max load: 10A / 2200W resistive load. Not rated for inductive loads like large motors or compressors
above 1200W — using it with high-draw appliances beyond rating can trip the plug's internal breaker
repeatedly, which is expected safety behavior, not a defect.

Requires a neutral wire at the socket (standard in most Indian households) — no hub required.

# Product: NovaVolt NV100 Wireless Earbuds

Price: ₹2,499. Bluetooth 5.3, 6 hours playback per charge (24 hours with the charging case), IPX4 splash
resistance, touch controls for play/pause/skip/volume, built-in mic for calls.

Box contents: NV100 earbuds, charging case, USB-C cable, 3 sizes of ear tips (S/M/L), quick start guide.

Compatibility: works with any Bluetooth 5.0+ device (Android, iOS, Windows, most TVs with Bluetooth).
No app required for basic use; the optional "NovaVolt Connect" app (Android/iOS) unlocks EQ presets
and firmware updates.

Charging case takes ~1.5 hours for a full charge via USB-C; earbuds fast-charge to 1 hour of playback in
10 minutes in the case.

# Troubleshooting: PD65 Charger Not Charging Laptop 1. Confirm your laptop's port actually supports USB-C Power Delivery charging — some laptops have a USB-C port that is data-only and will never charge from any USB-C charger, including the PD65. 2. Try the included cable first; third-party USB-C cables that don't support 5A/20V PD can silently fail to deliver full power even though the connector fits. 3. Check the adapter's LED (if present on your laptop) or battery icon for a "slow charging" vs "not charging" indicator — many laptops will trickle-charge at low power if the system is under heavy load, which looks like a fault but isn't. 4. If the adapter doesn't charge any device at all, this indicates an adapter fault and is covered under the 1-year warranty — do not open or attempt to repair the adapter yourself, as this voids warranty.

# Troubleshooting: NV100 Earbuds Won't Pair 1. Make sure both earbuds are in the case with the lid open, and the LED is blinking white (pairing mode). If the LED isn't blinking, press and hold the case button for 5 seconds to force pairing mode. 2. On your phone, forget/remove any existing "NovaVolt NV100" entry from Bluetooth settings before re-pairing — a stale pairing record is the most common cause of silent pairing failures. 3. Keep the earbuds within 1m of the phone during the initial pair; move away only after the connection is confirmed. 4. If one earbud pairs but not the other, place both back in the case for 10 seconds to resync them, then take them out

but not the other, place both back in the case for 10 seconds to resync them, then take them out together. 5. If pairing still fails after a full case recharge (case LED should go solid red while charging, then off when full), the issue may be hardware-related — this should be escalated for a warranty check rather than retried indefinitely.

# Troubleshooting: SP2 Smart Plug Shows Offline 1. The SP2 only supports 2.4GHz Wi-Fi networks. If your router broadcasts a combined SSID for 2.4GHz and 5GHz, the plug may have associated with the 5GHz band and will never connect — create a separate 2.4GHz-only SSID temporarily for setup if needed. 2. Power-cycle the plug (unplug for 10 seconds) and check that the LED is fast-blinking blue (setup mode) before attempting to reconnect it in the app. 3. Reset the plug by holding the button for 5 seconds until the LED blinks rapidly, then redo setup from scratch in the NovaVolt Home app. 4. Router-side MAC filtering or guest-network client isolation can block the plug even after it joins Wi-Fi successfully

Home app. 4. Router-side MAC filtering or guest-network client isolation can block the plug even after it joins Wi-Fi successfully — check router settings if the plug connects but still shows "offline" in-app. 5. If the plug repeatedly drops offline after a successful setup (not a setup failure), this is likely a hardware fault and should be escalated for a warranty/replacement check rather than repeated resets.

# Troubleshooting: BS5 Speaker Connects but No Sound 1. Check the volume on both the source device AND the speaker itself (the speaker has its own physical volume buttons, independent of phone volume). 2. If paired via Bluetooth, confirm the phone/laptop's audio output is actually routed to the BS5 and not still playing through the device's internal speaker — this is the most common cause of "silent" pairing. 3. If using the 3.5mm aux-in, note that plugging in an aux cable disables Bluetooth audio automatically; unplug the aux cable to return to Bluetooth mode. 4. # Warranty Policy — NovaVolt Electronics All NovaVolt-branded products carry a 1-year manufacturer warranty against manufacturing defects, starting from the delivery date. Power banks and chargers carry a 6-month warranty on the battery cell specifically (the casing and ports remain covered for 1 year). Warranty does NOT cover: physical damage (drops, cracks, liquid damage), damage from using a non-NovaVolt charger/cable, unauthorized repair attempts, or normal cosmetic wear. To claim warranty service, contact support with your order ID and a description/photo of the issue. If approved, we offer either a repair (via our service center, 7-10 business days) or a replacement unit, at NovaVolt's discretion based on stock availability.
